purpose: Corrección visual solicitada: titulo integrado/paleta natural con ámbar localizado; historia/textos originales preservados.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: one finished 1024x1536 Spanish comic page, a style correction of an existing published page.

INPUTS:
Image1 is the EDIT TARGET: chapter5 page1. Preserve its story, six sequential panels, speakers, scenes, poses and full school uniforms.
Image2 is the DRAWING STYLE REFERENCE: chapter1 page1. Match its expressive ink-and-paint finish, natural skin, character proportions and restrained warm light. This reference supplies style only; keep the target's characters and events.
Image3 is the PAGE PRESENTATION AND PALETTE REFERENCE: chapter4 page1. Match its quiet cream gutters, clean black panel frames, discreet page header and integrated chapter-title cartouche. Its classroom and sports clothing do not replace the target's Potions classroom or uniforms.

PRIMARY CORRECTION:
Bring Image1 back into the visual family of Images2-3. Soften the excessive orange saturation and bright rim-light; preserve visible detail in robes, stone, wood and skin. Keep AMBER lamps and COPPER cauldrons because the changed classroom lighting is part of the story. Amber should be localized to lamps/reflections, with natural skin, brown hair, neutral stone, dark wood and balanced house colors. Preserve natural expressive proportions rather than enlarging eyes/heads into a different character model.

PAGE PRESENTATION:
Small black serif header at the upper left, exactly: "Capítulo 5 · 01".
The title "Sentimientos" appears ONCE in a modest CREAM cartouche integrated into the upper-right opening panel showing the Potions classroom. It is not a giant second heading outside the artwork. Adjust opening-panel framing only as necessary to keep the art and title legible. Maintain SIX panels and their Western reading order.
Cream gutters, consistent crisp black frames, readable white speech balloons with tails pointing to the correct person. Keep all visible dialogue exactly as on the target; do not invent narration.

STORY AND IDENTITIES TO PRESERVE:
1. Pansy descends the stone stairs toward the dungeons, wearing her backpack and full Slytherin school uniform.
2. View of the empty Potions classroom, closed ingredient cabinets and new copper cauldrons under amber lamps. The chapter-title cartouche belongs here.
3. Hermione reads at the desk; Pansy arrives and says: "Granger."
4. Hermione responds: "Pans… Parkinson, hola."
5. Pansy asks: "¿Sabes por qué cambiaron la iluminación?"
6. Hermione answers: "No. Pero los calderos también son distintos."

Hermione: voluminous CURLY BROWN hair, freckles, BROWN eyes, white shirt, gray sweater, BURGUNDY/GOLD Gryffindor tie and long dark robe with burgundy lining.
Pansy: straight chin-length BLACK bob, GREEN eyes, white shirt, gray sweater, GREEN/SILVER Slytherin tie and long dark robe with green lining.
Both are ordinary fully dressed school pupils, seated/standing naturally in a classroom conversation. One copy of each person in each undivided panel. Same books, backpack and empty copper cauldrons as target. Keep the target's calm humorous expressions and scene continuity.

Return one complete finished page. No extra characters, dialogue, chapter labels, decorative red flourishes, signatures or embedded watermark. The reader supplies the author's credit separately.

Use case: lighting-weather. Edit Image1 ONLY in color and illumination, preserving every pixel-level drawing decision as closely as possible: all six panels, positions, facial expressions, eye colors, character proportions, poses, robes, clothing, objects, exact Spanish text, header and Sentimientos title cartouche. Image1 is the target page already corrected for layout. Image2 is an early-comic style/color reference only.
Correct the remaining strong global orange color cast. Use NEUTRAL GRAY stone, NATURAL LIGHT PEACH skin, genuinely DARK BROWN Hermione hair with subtle brown highlights rather than orange outline, BLACK Pansy hair with restrained neutral shine, detailed BLACK/CHARCOAL robes. Preserve BROWN Hermione eyes, GREEN Pansy eyes, BURGUNDY-GOLD Gryffindor and GREEN-SILVER Slytherin colors. Lighting is a SOFT NEUTRAL AMBIENT FILL throughout the classroom, with localized AMBER light visible only in the lamps and nearby copper reflections. Skin and hair should not glow orange, background stone should read gray-brown, wood dark brown. The COPPER cauldrons remain copper with smaller restrained warm highlights and readable shadows. Reduce the broad orange edge-light/rimlight on hair and clothes. Keep natural expressive ink-and-paint shading, not a monochrome or desaturated wash.
Do not redraw or enlarge eyes, heads or bodies; do not change any panel's camera, line art, speech-balloon tail or Spanish text. Keep title in upper-right opening panel and header at upper-left. Return one complete finished portrait page, no added words/signatures/watermark.

review: Aprobación visual y transcripción fiel antes de incorporar; masters/variantes anteriores conservados.
